children: Director Aryeh Jason sold 2,111 shares of common stock in transactions dated October 30 and November 2, 2026. The October 30 sales were at prices ranging from $317.74 to $320.49 per share; the 700 shares sold on November 2 were at a weighted-average price of $320.4261 per share. The total sale amount was approximately $676,158. After the transactions, Jason directly owned 108,758 shares and indirectly owned 8,000 shares.
